The learner asks specifically: Make sure one of the senses is this meaning: the part of the leg you stand on.

notes: पैर refers to both the foot and the whole leg; टाँग refers specifically to the leg.

senses.definition: The lower part of the leg on which a person or animal stands and walks.

examples.text: मेरे पैर में चोट लगी है।

senses.definition: The entire lower limb used for standing, walking, and running.

examples.text: दौड़ने से मेरे पैर थक गए हैं।
examples.translation: My legs are tired from running.

notes: In Hindi, the word 'पैर' (pēr) is commonly used to refer to both the foot and the entire leg, depending on the context.
If you need to be very specific about the lower part you stand on, you can say 'पंजों' (panjō - toes/front of foot) or 'तलवा' (talvā - sole), but 'पैर' is almost always sufficient.

faults.quote: you can say 'पंजों' (panjō - toes/front of foot)
faults.why: पंजों is the oblique plural, not the lemma (पंजा), and rather than পंजा/तलवा, learners need टाँग (leg).
